notes:
**Update: lines to exits and points of interest, a faded map edge, Steam map fix**

Short version: the map can now draw lines to the exits, the next area and the places you want, with the style you pick. A corner map fades out in a soft arch, and the map hack reads the Steam client again.

## New

**Lines on the map (Markers, Minimap tab)**
- Waypoint, exit, entry and point-of-interest lines each have their own style (Solid, Pulse or Wave), colour and thickness.
- Exit means the way on along the story. Entry is the way back. Points of interest are the places you want, picked one by one: dungeons, quest places, Khalim's chests, the Staff of Kings chest, the Staff orifice in the real Tal Rasha tomb, racks (shield or crossed swords) and more.
- Points of interest also get markers on the map.

**Map edge fade**
- A corner map fades out in an arch from its screen corner instead of ending in straight lines. Controls: Fade area, Softness, Arch fade, and Fade the markers too.

**Drop list**
- The drop list is its own switch, in On Screen, and no longer follows Markers on/off. An **OPEN** button opens your NIP in Notepad.
- Runes are orange, ethereal and socketed items grey, rares yellow. Rare ethereal items and runes show when your NIP lists them.

**Party info** has its own position, colour and Exocet font, no longer tied to a map type.

## Fixed

- **Steam:** the map hack read no character on the Steam client because an old saved offsets entry belonged to the Battle.net build. It is now ignored when it does not match the client's own table.
- **Prebuff:** the Prebuff hotkey and its setup now survive a restart.
- A corner map is no longer hidden when you toggle items.

Tickets and feedback are always welcome. Use **REQUEST FEATURE** in the top bar.
